title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: Apply the answer method to multiple-choice and multiple-response questions; recognize the most common look-alike services; use the whole-course review sheet
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide

toc.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse

html:
1The pairs the exam likes to confuse

Pair The difference
SQS / SNS / EventBridge queue pulled by consumers / push to many subscribers / rule-based event router
Standard / FIFO queue at-least-once and unordered / exactly-once and ordered per group
Cognito user pool / identity pool sign-in and tokens / temporary AWS credentials
Secrets Manager / Parameter Store rotation, billed per secret / cheap configuration, no rotation
SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS / SSE-C / client-side S3 keys / KMS keys with audit / your key per request / encrypted before upload
Query / Scan (DynamoDB) one partition key efficiently / the whole table
LSI / GSI same partition key, table creation only / any keys, eventual consistency
ElastiCache / DAX cache for anything / cache for DynamoDB
Reserved / provisioned concurrency guarantee and cap / no cold starts
X-Ray annotations / metadata indexed and searchable / not indexed
CodeBuild / CodeDeploy / CodePipeline build and test / deploy revisions / orchestrate stages
Blue/green / canary / rolling two environments and a switch / small share first / batches

2Habits that score points

Habit Why
Roles, not access keys The SDK uses role credentials; keys in code are always wrong
Managed feature first AWS expects the built-in service (DLQ, TTL, lifecycle, rotation)
Constraint words "least operational overhead", "cost-effective", "most secure", "no code change"
Multiple response Count the answers asked, select all
AI topics Review generated output; guardrails, private endpoints, human approval
Out of scope Architecture design, pipeline design, IAM administration, RAG design: not tested
Exam tip

. With no penalty for guessing, answer every question; flag hard ones and return with the time left.

Exam tip

. The 15 unscored questions are not marked, so give every question your full attention.

3Exam Q&A: final review

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A web app must stay responsive when traffic spikes and the back end is slow. What helps most?

  • APut work on an SQS queue read by workers
  • BCall the back end synchronously with no timeout
  • CDisable retries
  • DAdd a larger web server only
Show the answer

Answer: A. A queue decouples and absorbs spikes.

S2Which credentials should code running on Lambda use to call DynamoDB?

  • AAccess keys in environment variables
  • BThe function's execution role
  • CThe root user's keys
  • DHard-coded keys
Show the answer

Answer: B. Roles supply temporary credentials automatically.

S3A DynamoDB table is overloaded on one partition. What is the most likely fix?

  • AA higher-cardinality partition key
  • BA larger item size
  • CFewer indexes
  • DA scan
Show the answer

Answer: A. A high-cardinality key spreads requests.

S4Which option rotates database credentials automatically?

  • AParameter Store standard parameter
  • BS3 versioning
  • CCloudFront
  • DSecrets Manager
Show the answer

Answer: D. Secrets Manager rotates secrets.

S5How should a client handle throttling errors?

  • ARetry instantly in a loop
  • BIgnore them
  • CDelete the queue
  • DRetry with exponential backoff and jitter
Show the answer

Answer: D. Backoff with jitter relieves the service.

S6Which service shows where the time goes across several services in one request?

  • AAWS CloudTrail
  • BAWS KMS
  • CAWS X-Ray
  • DAmazon S3
Show the answer

Answer: C. X-Ray traces requests across services.

S7Which feature keeps AI traffic off the public internet?

  • AA public IP address
  • BA longer timeout
  • CA bigger model
  • DAn interface VPC endpoint
Show the answer

Answer: D. PrivateLink keeps traffic on the AWS network.

S8A release should go to 10 percent of users first and roll back on alarms. What fits?

  • AAll at once
  • BDeleting the old version
  • CA canary deployment through CodeDeploy
  • DA manual copy
Show the answer

Answer: C. Canary releases limit the blast radius.

S9What is the minimum passing score on DVA-C03?

  • A700
  • B720
  • C750
  • D800
Show the answer

Answer: B. The minimum passing score is 720.

3.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing score?

Show the answer

720 on a scale of 100 to 1,000.

R2What are the four domain weights?

Show the answer

30, 26, 22 and 22 percent.

R3Which domain is new in AI content?

Show the answer

AI appears across domains, with Task 2.3 (securing AI services) entirely new.

R4What is the default SQS visibility timeout?

Show the answer

30 seconds.

R5What does a Cognito identity pool provide?

Show the answer

Temporary AWS credentials.

R6What is the Lambda timeout limit?

Show the answer

15 minutes.

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Exam 50 scored + 15 unscored, 720 to pass, no guessing penalty, multiple response needs all answers
Domains 30 development, 26 security, 22 testing and deployment, 22 troubleshooting and optimization

Always answer every question
